# Micropreneur Starter documentation

> Public, machine-readable guidance for building and extending a Micropreneur Starter fork.

## Complete corpus

- [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt): all public guides, component docs, and agent skills in one file
- [agent-content.json](/agent-content.json): structured document and skill metadata

## Getting started

- [Introduction](/getting-started/introduction.md): Understand what Starter includes, where product code belongs, and what to replace in your first fork.
- [Running locally](/getting-started/running-locally.md): Start the web app, docs, D1 database, registry, and focused feedback loops without production secrets.
- [Project structure](/getting-started/project-structure.md): Find the application composition root, provider adapters, removable domain example, and source-delivered UI.
- [Writing documentation](/getting-started/writing-documentation.md): Build readable MDX guides with callouts, numbered steps, command tabs, and live Elements registry previews.

## Integrations

- [Better Auth](/integrations/better-auth.md): Configure credential authentication and optional Google OAuth through the default AuthPort adapter.
- [Descope](/integrations/descope.md): Understand the typed Descope adapter seam, its current limitations, and the work required to make it functional.
- [Resend email](/integrations/resend.md): Switch from deterministic local email capture to verified Resend delivery on Cloudflare Workers.
- [Stripe billing](/integrations/stripe.md): Activate the complete one-plan Stripe engine or choose Starter Pro for a billing flow that is already wired.

## Cloudflare

- [Deploy to Cloudflare](/cloudflare/deployment.md): Create the D1 database, configure Worker bindings and secrets, apply remote migrations, and deploy deliberately.
- [R2 file uploads](/cloudflare/r2-file-uploads.md): Enable owner-scoped avatar and workspace-logo uploads with short-lived presigned R2 URLs.

## Elements

- [Install Elements Free](/elements/installing-free.md): Browse the public registry and install source-owned components and themes with the shadcn CLI.
- [Elements Pro](/elements/elements-pro.md): Understand the future authenticated registry contract without including premium source or a license gate in Starter.
- [Component gallery](/elements/gallery.md): Browse every public Elements component with live previews and install commands.

## Agents

- [MCP Server](/agents/mcp-server.md): Connect coding agents to public Starter documentation, skills, themes, and Elements through one read-only endpoint.
- [Agent Skills](/agents/agent-skills.md): Share one canonical Starter workflow with repository agents and standards-based web discovery.
- [LLMs Integration](/agents/llms-integration.md): Consume Starter guides as raw Markdown, concise LLM indexes, or a structured public content manifest.

## Components

- [Button](/components/button.md): A Base UI-backed action control with semantic variants.
- [Card](/components/card.md): A composed object container with header, content, action, footer slots, and a clipped-corner brand variant.
- [Badge](/components/badge.md): A compact property chip with semantic variants.
- [Table](/components/table.md): Thin-ruled table primitives with wide-tracked uppercase headers.
- [StatusBadge](/components/status-badge.md): A compact semantic property indicator for common lifecycle states.
- [DataGrid](/components/data-grid.md): A typed read-only grid foundation for object collections.
- [LedgerList](/components/ledger-list.md): A horizontal ledger-style row list with name, meta, mono figure, and status slots.
- [MarginNote](/components/margin-note.md): A small editorial annotation with a burnt-orange marker detail.
- [IndexLabel](/components/index-label.md): A tiny zero-padded index number in mono with wide tracking.
- [MilestoneMarker](/components/milestone-marker.md): A vertical milestone list with circular markers and connecting rules.
- [EmptyState](/components/empty-state.md): A branded empty state with serif headline, muted copy, and an action slot.
- [DashboardShell](/components/dashboard-shell.md): A responsive application shell with navigation, header, metric slots, and a content workspace.
- [AuthCard](/components/auth-card.md): A provider-neutral authentication card with accessible credential fields and action slots.
- [SettingsLayout](/components/settings-layout.md): A responsive settings shell with local navigation, page context, and a focused content region.
- [FilterableDataTable](/components/filterable-data-table.md): A typed table workflow with local search, a semantic filter, loading, empty, and error states.

## Agent skills

- [starter-repo](/skills/starter-repo.md): Make narrow, verified changes to a fork of micropreneur/starter.

## MCP

Connect to `https://docs.micropreneur.dev/mcp`, or run `pnpm --filter @micropreneur/mcp dev` for local stdio access.
